summary: A committee changes which replacement parts count by looking at what an authorized shop can obtain.
realLife: Washington HB 1483 (2025). The House substitute shifted the definition from parts used by an authorized provider to parts the manufacturer makes available to one, while retaining generally available parts.
inGame: needs: a committee compares the original and substitute definitions against a disputed part.
gates: A committee compares the original and substitute definitions against a disputed part.

turns.writesBack: The order sheet supports including the part.
